summary: KPET Ultra Paceline Corp. filed an 8-K on May 21, 2026, announcing the separate trading of its Class A ordinary shares and warrants from its units effective the same date. The units were part of its initial public offering. No fractional warrants are issued; only whole warrants trade under KPET.WS. The separate trading allows holders to split the units into the underlying securities, with units continuing as KPET.U. This is a routine operational announcement, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, premiums, or strategic events. The filing is a standard current report for a SPAC post-IPO unit separation.
